caption: The drawing features three square sections arranged in a triangular composition against a light beige background. The upper left section shows a colored illustration of a tile in shades of brown, green, and blue, with a raised pattern of an eight-pointed star and connecting lines forming geometric shapes. The upper right section contains a similar square outline, but inside it shows a red line drawing of four tiles in a 2x2 grid, each with the same eight-pointed star and geometric pattern as the illustrated tile on the left. The lower central section displays a three-dimensional line drawing, also in red, showing the same geometric tile in perspective, emphasizing its thickness and angular design. The sections are separated by ample blank space on the page.
title: Brick Sidewalk Tiles
